facts.business: Adtech Systems Limited is a leading solution provider in the electronic security and surveillance industry, providing integrated and cost-effective electronic security solutions supported by technical expertise and after-sales service.
key_risks: Geopolitical conflicts and their impact on global trade and energy markets
Monetary policy decisions of major central banks
Trade policies, tariffs and increasing trade fragmentation
Developments in the Chinese economy and other major emerging markets
Supply-chain diversification and regionalisation of manufacturing
Rapid technological developments, particularly in artificial intelligence, automation and digitalisation
Climate-related events and the transition towards sustainable economic activity
Uncertain tax positions in respect of matters under dispute with tax authorities
Revenue recognition judgments under Ind AS 115
facts.related_party_note: The Company is in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 where applicable, for all transactions with the related parties and the details of related party transactions have been disclosed in the standalone financial statements as required by the applicable accounting standards.
